name: aps-skills
description: Agent-agnostic skills for evaluating manuscripts against the APS / Physical Review journal portfolio.
load_order: skills/aps-reference-format/SKILL.md (when building or auditing the reference list)

skills.name: aps-common
skills.description: Shared APS/Physical Review policies, house conventions, and vocabulary. Load once alongside any journal-specific APS skill; never duplicate this content into a journal skill.

skills.name: aps-format-and-presentation
skills.description: Determine how a manuscript should be built for a specific APS journal — length and article type, figure strategy and compression, main-text vs Supplemental Material, section structure, and narrative style. Load alongside any journal skill when advising on manuscript construction or revision.

skills.name: aps-journal-selector
skills.description: Choose the best APS/Physical Review journal for a manuscript. Extracts the scientific contribution, shortlists candidates, evaluates each against its journal skill, ranks them, and explains why the winner beats the runner-up. Start here for any "where should I submit?" question.

skills.name: aps-manuscript-reviewer
skills.description: Assess a manuscript the way an APS editor and referee would — scientific soundness, novelty, evidence, and the specific objections likely to be raised — separately from journal fit. Use before or alongside aps-journal-selector.

skills.name: aps-mathematical-presentation
skills.description: Evaluate and improve how equations, derivations, and quantitative arguments function as scientific content in an APS manuscript — what the central contribution's mathematical object is, which equations belong in the main text, and how formulation connects to figures. Load alongside any journal skill for theoretical, computational, or equation-driven work.

skills.name: aps-reference-format
skills.description: Build, audit, or fix an APS/Physical Review manuscript's reference list — numbering and citation mechanics, what must be listed, author-count rules, e-print and unpublished-work handling, and the ethical referencing standard APS states explicitly (comprehensiveness, no self-citation inflation). Load alongside any journal skill when reviewing, drafting, or formatting references.

skills.name: aps-submission-assistant
skills.description: Prepare an APS submission package — cover letter, criteria justification, article-type and section selection, checklist, and response-to-referees — once the target journal is chosen.

skills.name: aps-apsos
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for APS Open Science — APS's community-driven open access journal for rigorous research across the scientific process, including data, software, replications, and null results.

skills.name: aps-pra
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review A — atomic, molecular, and optical physics, foundations of quantum mechanics, and quantum science.

skills.name: aps-prab
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Accelerators and Beams — accelerator science, technology, and applications. Fully open access at no cost to authors.
skills.access_model: gold open access, sponsor-funded (no author charge)

skills.name: aps-prapplied
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Applied — applied physics at the interfaces with engineering, materials science, chemistry, biology, and medicine.

skills.name: aps-prb
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review B (condensed matter and materials physics), compare it against neighboring APS journals, and advise on positioning.

skills.name: aps-prc
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review C — APS's journal for experimental and theoretical nuclear physics.

skills.name: aps-prd
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review D — particles, fields, gravitation, cosmology, astrophysics, and physics/cosmology-related astronomy.

skills.name: aps-pre
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review E — statistical, nonlinear, complex systems, biological, soft matter, fluids, plasma, and computational physics including machine learning and AI.

skills.name: aps-prfluids
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Fluids — all aspects of fluid dynamics research.

skills.name: aps-prl
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Letters — APS's flagship short-format journal for the most influential developments across all of physics.

skills.name: aps-prmaterials
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Materials — APS's multidisciplinary journal for materials research across physics, chemistry, and engineering.

skills.name: aps-prper
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Physics Education Research — experimental and theoretical research on the teaching and learning of physics and astronomy.

skills.name: aps-prresearch
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review Research — APS's broad, multidisciplinary gold open access journal covering all topics with a connection to physics.

skills.name: aps-prx
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Physical Review X — APS's highly selective, flexible-length gold open access journal for breakthrough and paradigm-shifting physics.

skills.name: aps-prxenergy
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for PRX Energy — APS's highly selective gold open access journal for renewable and sustainable energy research.

skills.name: aps-prxintelligence
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for PRX Intelligence — APS's highly selective gold open access journal for AI/ML that advances the physical sciences. Load this whenever a manuscript's central contribution is a machine-learning method, tool, dataset, or insight.

skills.name: aps-prxlife
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for PRX Life — APS's highly selective gold open access journal at the intersection of biology with physics, computer science, mathematics, and engineering.

skills.name: aps-prxquantum
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for PRX Quantum — APS's highly selective gold open access journal for quantum information science and technology.

skills.name: aps-rmp
skills.description: Evaluate a manuscript's fit for Reviews of Modern Physics — APS's premier venue for in-depth Reviews and Colloquia across all of physics.

principles: equations are scientific content, not formatting
never invent notation for a manuscript
format is not uniform across the portfolio — never generalize a limit
label presentation advice REQUIREMENT / CONVENTION / STRATEGY
no APS journal states a figure-count limit
referencing is an editorial standard (comprehensiveness, no self-citation inflation), not just formatting
